verdict.rationale: Google Drive API documents push notifications that fire when watched resources change (docs-9, docs-19, docs-28), confirming webhook-style change notifications exist. However, the evidence pack does not include documentation of verification mechanisms (e.g., channel token/signature checks) or retry/backoff semantics for delivery failures. missing for 10: documented verification steps (token/header validation), retry/backoff guarantees on notification delivery, and independent confirmation of reliability.
